title: Stage Finding (merged with reachability trace)
description: A vulnerability finding produced by the auditor/hunter stage, including the structured reachability verdict that previously came from the tracer stage (TRACE merged into HUNT, 2026-08-21). Must pass validation before advancing to VALIDATE.

vuln_class.description: Vulnerability class/type (CWE-family semantic name; exact CWE-ID goes in report stage)

language.description: Primary language of the vulnerable code

file.description: Source file path relative to repo root

sink.description: The dangerous function or operation (e.g. strcpy, memcpy, system, popen, eval, open, setuid)

entry_point.description: How attacker-controlled input reaches this code path (input source: network, CLI argv, file, env, config, DBus message)

confidence.description: How sure the auditor is this is exploitable

evidence.description: Structural call path and reasoning, entry → sink. Include relevant code snippets.

attacker_model.description: Who the attacker is (unprivileged local user, remote network, same-user sandbox, DBus any-user, setuid context, etc.)

subsystem.description: Which subsystem of the target this affects

trace_result.description: Whether attacker-controlled input reaches the sink. Produced by the auditor (HUNT) as part of the merged finding+trace contract.

call_chain.description: The function call path from entry point to sink

items.description: One step in the chain: file:function → next:function

data_flow.description: Taint path description: how the attacker-controlled value is transformed from entry to sink (e.g. argv[1] → strlen(x)+1 → memcpy(dst,src,n)). Include value-level transformations, not just function names.

defenses_checked.description: Every defense examined on the path and whether it blocked the attacker

verdict.description: Whether the defense stops the attacker

reachability_basis.description: Basis for the reachability verdict: in-tree (verified tree path), export-contract (export symbol with no in-tree callers is a designed external call surface), external-context (explicit auditor-provided ecosystem knowledge)

impact_if_reachable.description: What an attacker gains by reaching this sink (required when REACHABLE)

unreachable_reason.description: Why the sink is unreachable (required when UNREACHABLE)
